annotations.title: TikTok bid protection status and credit history

description: Whether TikTok's BID PROTECTION is covering a Smart+ campaign or ad group, and what it actually paid back. Bid protection compensates in AD CREDITS when delivery misses the bid, so this answers two different questions from one tool: with no dates it returns today's coverage STATUS per id; with startDate and endDate it returns the day-by-day HISTORY, each row carrying the credit amount and currency. Smart+ objects ONLY — a classic TikTok campaign id does not resolve here. TikTok keeps 60 days, and the two endpoints size differently: status takes up to 200 ids, history allows 200 DIVIDED BY the day span (a 10-day window takes 20 ids), which is refused here with the arithmetic done rather than by TikTok with it left to you. An id TikTok says nothing about is NAMED in the reply, because a short list otherwise reads as 'those are unprotected'. Read-only, 0 credits.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after startDate and within 60 days of it

level.description: which Smart+ level the ids are

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the ad account timezone. With endDate this returns HISTORY instead of status; must be within the last 60 days
